notAllowed.body: The server protects {{branch}}. Your commits wait on this device. Put them on a new branch and open a change request.

other.body: Your commits wait on this device. Read what the server said, and try again.

unsigned.title: {{library}} accepts only signed commits.
unsigned.body: The server refused commits that are not signed. Your commits wait on this device. Sign them and push again.

incoming.becomesGlobal: {{skill}} is no longer in {{repos}}. It becomes available everywhere.
